free_tier.stated: 5 GB total file storage per organization on Cloud Free — not per user. Standard/Plus are 5 GB/25 GB per user.

egress.terms: Free and unmetered; files served from the realm's upload host.

tooling: Zulip REST API `POST /api/v1/user_uploads` (multipart) and the returned `uri` fetches directly. Python client `zulip`, plus `zulip-terminal` for humans.
chaining: Orgs are free and self-serve, but each org is a separate Zulip Cloud realm — the multiplier is N orgs x 5 GB, i.e. exactly the 'trivially repeatable at scale' case. Not unlimited.
limits_note: 10 MB per file on Free (1 GB per file only on paid plans); 10,000 messages of searchable history on Free; large uploads 'may fail to upload using this API endpoint due to network limitations'.
reliability_note: Stable, no expiry on attachments. The 5 GB org cap is a hard wall — uploads start failing rather than degrading.

evidence.proved: 'The Zulip Cloud Free plan includes a total of 5 GB of file storage. Each uploaded file can be up to 10 MB.'
'File storage up to 5 GB total' (Free); '5 GB per user' (Standard); '25 GB per user' (Plus)
